package lengths_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/rpclengths/gen/jsonrpc/lengths/client"
	svc "example.com/rpclengths/gen/lengths"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
)

func TestRequestFraming(t *testing.T) {
	wire, err := json.Marshal(&jsonrpc.Request{JSONRPC: "2.0", Method: "send", ID: "call", Params: map[string]string{"value": "x"}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	length := int64(len(wire))
	seen := make(chan int64, 1)
	host := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, readErr := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		if readErr != nil {
			t.Error(readErr)
		}
		if int64(len(body)) != length {
			t.Errorf("body length %d want %d", len(body), length)
		}
		seen <- r.ContentLength
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if _, writeErr := io.WriteString(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"call","result":null}`); writeErr != nil {
			t.Error(writeErr)
		}
	}))
	defer host.Close()
	c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	_, err = c.Send()(context.Background(), &svc.SendPayload{ID: "call", Length: &length, Value: "x"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, length, <-seen)
}
